## Product requirements and override gates

### `LM3-CWL-P010` — end-cowl fiberglass laminate, insert, adhesive, and coupon material kit

Default: **Gurit — SE 130FR / ST 130FR prepreg with SA130FR and SF130FR films**.

Published reference facts:

- EN 45545 HL2 stated for R1/R7/R17 monolithic laminates
- 85 deg C low-temperature cure option
- 45 minute cure option at 120 deg C
- published reinforcement and film order codes

Affordability/localisation basis: Use the catalogue prepreg as the first-article material; cut, vacuum-bag, cure, trim and repair locally with batch coupons.

Close before supplier freeze:

- select reinforcement/core/film stack per component
- fire-test the actual sandwich laminate
- run environmental, insert, impact and repair qualification

Override the default when:

- the selected order code exceeds the controlled design-reference envelope
- vehicle load, duty, thermal, EMC, fire, accessibility or RAM calculations require another rating
- the quoted configuration lacks the required rail evidence or lifecycle support
- a qualified local equivalent has lower whole-life cost after interface and regression testing

### `LM3-FAS-P030` — front glazing/lamp EPDM seal, drain rail, washer sleeve, and edge-closeout kit
